CustomField.description: SAFETY GATE (deterministic, read BEFORE generation). customer_safe = eligible to draft to a customer; agent_only = internal reference, surfaced to the agent but never drafted; escalate_only = flip orchestration to the escalation branch, do not draft. Default agent_only: a forgotten/ambiguous classification costs recall (recoverable), never a leak. Seeded from space/label at ingestion; raw inputs kept in Source_Space_Key__c/Source_Labels__c so it can be re-derived without re-fetch.
CustomField.label: Visibility
